(Central News Agency File Photo) Newtalk News (Central News Agency reporter Ye Zhentaoyuan 6th) A retired Air Force captain surnamed Fei is suspected of collecting personal information and the whereabouts of two intelligence personnel in Taiwan and delivering it to the Chinese side, instructing his son to help in the process. The Taoyuan District Prosecutor's Office sued Fei's father and son today, and the Taoyuan District Court ruled that Fei's father was detained in March and prohibited from receiving communications. Peach inspection investigation. After retiring from the army, Captain Fei served as a township chief in a township in Hebei Province, China, and engaged in espionage for China.
